entries.name: Weak Mixing Angle
entries.physical_mechanism: Electroweak gauge coupling ratio from SU(2)×U(1) symmetry breaking
entries.derivation_notes: The Weinberg angle represents the mixing between weak isospin and hypercharge. The ratio 3/13 emerges from the geometric structure of gauge group generators.
entries.z2_connection: Direct - ratio of gauge coupling constants expressible as simple fraction

entries.name: Dark Energy Density Fraction
entries.physical_mechanism: Holographic principle - ratio of bulk to boundary degrees of freedom
entries.derivation_notes: The dark energy fraction represents the geometric balance between vacuum energy and matter density in a holographic universe.

entries.name: Fine Structure Constant Inverse
entries.physical_mechanism: Electromagnetic coupling from geometric quantization of charge
entries.derivation_notes: The fine structure constant inverse emerges from the 4-dimensional geometric structure plus a 3-fold symmetry factor.

entries.name: Heat Capacity Ratio (Monoatomic)
entries.physical_mechanism: Degrees of freedom: (D+2)/D where D=3 spatial dimensions
entries.derivation_notes: For monoatomic ideal gas, γ = Cp/Cv = (f+2)/f where f=3 translational DOF. This is (3+2)/3 = 5/3.

entries.name: Tetrahedral Bond Angle
entries.physical_mechanism: Geometric constraint of 4 equivalent bonds from central atom
entries.derivation_notes: The tetrahedral angle is arccos(-1/3) ≈ 109.47°, arising from the geometry of sp³ hybridization.

entries.name: Lotka-Volterra Phase Shift
entries.physical_mechanism: Linear stability analysis of predator-prey equations
entries.derivation_notes: Predator population lags prey by exactly π/2 radians (90°) in the linearized Lotka-Volterra system.

entries.name: Benford's Law First Digit
entries.physical_mechanism: Scale invariance leads to logarithmic distribution
entries.derivation_notes: P(d) = log₁₀(1 + 1/d). For d=1, P(1) = log₁₀(2) ≈ 0.301.
